source_acceptance.scope: Current concept only; does not accept this portrait or advance a model stage.

observations.identity: The golden monkey face, pointed chin fur, swept flame crest, paired spiral gold circlet, red armor and gold dragon shoulders preserve the current own-project design. The crest is taller and the paired spiral relief is interpreted more prominently than in the concept; this is a generated interpretation, not an exact face transfer.
observations.craftsmanship: Sculpted fur masses, detailed painted red armor, leather straps and controlled gold highlights read as premium miniature bust art. Fine skin texture is realistic; this is generated artwork, not evidence of a physical resin miniature.
observations.background: Empty charcoal with a slight tonal gradient/noise; not numerically uniform. No lettering, watermark, UI, scenery or frame observed in the candidate.
observations.source_framing: Whole crest, ears, beard and circlet are visible. Crest tip is only about 2 percent below the upper edge, rather than the requested 15 percent; head occupies substantially more than the requested 40 percent image height. Eye line is approximately 42 percent height and horizontally centered. Shoulder armor and chest continue through the square edges.
observations.circular_full100: Centered full100 circle preserves the whole head, ears, crest, circlet and beard. The crest is very close to the top arc. Lower dragon shoulder plates and chest are partly removed by the lower side arcs. This source has little tolerance for zoom, a smaller disc or a thick inward border.
observations.native_80: Golden crest, paired circlet, monkey facial structure, red armor and gold shoulders remain readable. Eyes remain dark light-separated marks; intricate fur and dragon relief merge.
observations.native_40: Golden head silhouette, face light-dark pattern, red armor and circlet color survive; individual irises, fine spiral definition and dragon anatomy do not resolve reliably. A 40 px thumbnail alone does not establish exact identity for an unfamiliar viewer.
